purpose: Canonical structured registry of major project claims. Seed set only — not every observation. Authoritative over informal prose in reports/ and historical snapshots. If a claim in this file conflicts with prose elsewhere in the repo, this file wins until a newer audit supersedes it.

claims.statement: As of 2026-04-09 there is no credible decrypt path for K4. All positive findings from this repo are descriptive anomalies, not solution candidates.
claims.red_team_status: accepted by Team of Rivals exhaustion audit 2026-04-08
claims.notes: This is the load-bearing current-state claim. Any new 'breakthrough' narrative must supersede this entry explicitly.

claims.statement: Single-layer and two-layer classical cipher space has been systematically tested under the direct-positional crib mapping. Three-layer space is partially explored.
claims.scope: carved CT, 97 chars, direct-positional crib mapping
claims.notes: Does not apply to ciphers where the crib positions are not in direct correspondence with CT positions (e.g. outer transposition before the cipher layers).

claims.statement: Composition framework v1+v2+v3 tested 105K+ branches across 37 campaigns. Maximum score 6/24 = noise.
claims.scope: 2-layer compositions (v1/v2) + 6 stateful/architecture families (v3) under direct-positional crib mapping
claims.notes: v3 families: band offset, polarity switch, progressive key, state alphabet, band polarity, compass offset.

claims.statement: Within the analyzed cipher class — columnar widths {4,6,8,9} × {Vigenère, Beaufort, Variant Beaufort}, applied to the carved 97-character CT under direct positional crib mapping — the full 242-inequality Bean constraint is violated by every (column-ordering, variant) pair. As a consequence, the elimination is running-key-source-independent within that class: no running-key source text can produce a solution in that class, because the Bean pre-filter empties before any source is consulted.
claims.scope: columnar w∈{4,6,8,9} × additive Vig/Beau/VarBeau, carved CT, direct positional crib mapping. Does NOT cover: composed ciphers with an outer layer preceding the columnar step, non-additive keystreams, cipher classes that break direct positional crib mapping, or columnar widths outside {4,6,8,9}.
claims.artifact: docs/elimination_tiers.md (Tier 1 rows for w4, w6/8/9, scope-corrected 2026-04-09); docs/exhaustion_certificate_2026_04_08.md §4-5 (scope-corrected 2026-04-09)
claims.red_team_status: independently re-verified 2026-04-09 from fresh interpreter; wording scope-corrected 2026-04-09 to close AUDIT-1
claims.notes: The arithmetic is correct and the claim is now precisely scoped. The prior 'SOURCE-INDEPENDENT' label was rewritten as 'running-key-source-independent within the analyzed class' across elimination_tiers.md, exhaustion_certificate_2026_04_08.md, admissibility_architecture.md, and c1_downgrade_basis_note_2026_04_08.md. AUDIT-1 is CLOSED as of 2026-04-09. Do NOT re-promote this to a universal impossibility claim without a new proof that covers composed ciphers with outer remapping layers.

claims.statement: Running-key has been demoted from a leading hypothesis to a residual admissible family: a finite checklist for documentation closure, not an open research front.
claims.scope: project priority, not a cryptanalytic statement
claims.red_team_status: explicit demotion by Team of Rivals 2026-04-08
claims.notes: Any proposal to re-elevate running-key must clear the red-team-before-swings rule and supersede this entry explicitly.

claims.statement: The 7-letter palette {B,G,I,K,O,W,Z} and all derived constructs (BCL enrichment, KA mod-5, AP enrichment, mod-35 table, Polybius row-selection, palette null separator) are retired as post-hoc selection artifacts.
claims.repro_reference: score-conditioned null experiment: SA produces 11 distinct letters on K4, p=0.30 vs shuffled controls
claims.notes: Original positional-null p=2.4e-5 was an artifact of using a null that did not match the SA discovery process. Retired files live under memory/retired/ with banners and stubs.

claims.statement: All autokey variants (Vigenère-autokey, Beaufort-autokey, CT-autokey-Vigenère, CT-autokey-Beaufort, Quagmire-II-autokey) are structurally impossible on K4 under the direct-positional crib mapping.
claims.scope: single-layer autokey under direct-positional crib mapping
claims.notes: Does not eliminate autokey as one layer of a multi-layer construction. DO NOT re-test under the direct-positional mapping.

claims.statement: The E-FRAC-54 joint detector (mono→trans→running-key) uses a quadgram-based score that is provably unable to beat FM-1 (Markov-3 adversarial null) at n=97. Therefore no search over this scorer can clear FM-1 regardless of search engineering.
claims.scope: E-FRAC-54 detector + any search built on top of its _score_nats
claims.notes: Re-classified from engineering-blocked to structurally-blocked-on-scorer. The correct next move is scoring research, not search engineering.

claims.statement: Public statements by Jim Sanborn carry no special evidentiary weight and are to be treated as Tier-3 community hearsay, not [PUBLIC FACT]. The physical sculpture is ground truth, not the artist.
claims.notes: This is a deliberate epistemic discipline policy. Do not silently re-promote Sanborn quotes to primary-source status.

claims.statement: Any Opus-compute swing of estimated cost ≥$25 must be red-teamed before pitching. Pattern-matching plausibility is not tractability analysis.
claims.notes: This rule downgraded C1/C2 from Opus compute to cheap-background closure on 2026-04-08.
